snippet.title: Memoirium First Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Memoirium is a retro soulslike set in a realm of dreams. As a Dreamer, you must defeat others like you in order to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294440/Memoirium/

I am happy to finally announce that the Steam page for Memoirium is finally up and that I have a wondrous new partnership with Outersloth!

I am eternally thankful and fortunate for their support. I will do my best to make this game the best version it can be.

Thank you as well to Inaf (@deltari_art on Twitter) for the art!

Join the Discord to stay updated on the latest about Memoirium: https://discord.com/invite/TjRAd8Pqwy

📱: https://www.tiktok.com/@goldengratus
